Welcome to NanoBrew Café! Customers come in, sit down and order from your menu. Your job: keep the food coming and turn your happiest customers into Synth staff.
Click a stove and pick a dish to cook. A server carries the finished batch to a free counter.
Your server carries dishes from the counter to the tables. After eating, customers pay your Cashier at the register.
That customer has a star — they loved it! Click them while they pay or walk out to spend your NanoBrew: they become a Synth.
Click one of your Synths to see its level and battery and to change its role.
The café is closed: it's night. Plan for tomorrow here, then press End Night.
Open the Menu tab and choose tomorrow's dishes. Customers love their favourites.
Open Night Ops, pick a MegaBean café and a squad, then Plan raid. Raids bring Nano Cores (for NanoBrew) and Influence.
Press End Night to see the night play out.
That's the basics! Take over the Alley by beating its flagship. Good luck.

Coins pay for dishes, upgrades and décor. NanoBrew converts a starred customer. Nano Cores (from raids) brew NanoBrew. Energy recharges Synths' batteries at night (2 coins each). Suspicion brings MegaBean raids — and at 90, a Corporate Audit. Influence unlocks the district's flagship.

Speed: how fast a Server carries dishes and batches, and how fast a Cashier takes payments. 1.0 is normal; +8% per level.
Cooking: as Chef, added to every stove's cooking speed (+60% makes stoves 1.6× faster). Several Chefs add up; +8% per level.
Appeal: as Greeter, customers arrive more often (+50% means 1.5× as many).
Power: damage per hit in raids and when defending the café. Grows 8% per level; low battery halves it.
HP: how much damage a Synth takes before it's knocked out of a fight. +8% per level; Security adds HP at home.
Battery: drains every second on duty. Below 20% a Synth works and fights at half strength; at 0 it stops. Max battery is rolled per unit (70–200). Recharged at night with Energy.
Level: XP comes from work (deliveries, batches, payments, greeting) and fights. Each level raises the stats that grow.
